why_best: Unbroken structural continuity maintains the user's focus and creates a feeling of frictionless momentum throughout the purchase flow.
why_bad: Crossfading between static layers or stepping through discrete screens destroys the sense of unified surface continuity and makes the system feel sluggish.
trap: A near-miss will complete the horizontal widening entirely before starting the vertical bloom, turning a seamless single gesture into two robotic, disjointed moves.
